method: Keep Wave55 February-trained second/third pair scores and add a February-standardized pre-deadline inner(boats1/2)-vs-outer(boats4/5/6) structural blend from national2, national3, motor3 and average ST. Evaluate a diagnostic lambda sensitivity grid on March. Maximum remains 3 tickets/race.
conclusion: The explicit inner-vs-outer structural blend does not improve Wave55. Every nonzero tested weight either loses captures, loses ROI, or both. Lambda 0 (unchanged Wave55 ranking) remains best: 27/71 capture and ROI 106.89%. This is useful negative evidence: do not force a coarse race-level inner/outer prior onto the pair ordering. Next work should refine opponent ranking at candidate/pair level, preferably with attack-mode proxies learned from February pre-race structure rather than a single aggregate inner/outer blend.
